Last quarter, management warned against headwinds to its business in the coming year.
“In our pharmacy services business, we expect the previously discussed market dynamics in our 340B business to continue and result in a headwind in 2027,” CFO Brian Newman said.

Additionally, Caremark is expected to see membership decline in 2027 due to product actions and market exits by health plan customers. Transition to a new pricing model is also expected to impact memberships.
